acceptance_detail.rule: PASS if the acceptance run's max absolute per-candidate log-likelihood difference is <= 2e-2 nats and every acc or acc_norm argmax disagreement has a top-two margin of our scores in that metric (log likelihood for acc, log likelihood per character for acc_norm) smaller than the observed max difference; otherwise FAIL

prompt_format: lm_eval 0.4.13 hellaswag (task version 1.0), zero-shot. context = preprocess(activity_label + ': ' + ctx_a + ' ' + ctx_b.capitalize()); choices = [preprocess(e) for e in endings]; continuation = ' ' + choice; label = int(label); preprocess = lm_eval.tasks.hellaswag.utils.preprocess. Encoding (causal encode-pair): trailing whitespace of the context moves to the continuation; whole = tokenizer.encode(context + continuation); ctx = tokenizer.encode(context); continuation tokens = whole[len(ctx):]; no BOS (tokenizer default); model input = whole[:-1]. Score = sum of continuation-token log probabilities (FP32 log-softmax, float64 sum). acc = argmax score; acc_norm = argmax score / len(choice) in characters, without the leading space.
